scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,seller,admin -c cyan,magenta,green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @vendora/web" "npm run dev --workspace @vendora/api" "npm run dev --workspace @vendora/seller-panel" "npm run dev --workspace @vendora/admin-panel"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:web" "npm run start:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vendora/shared && npm run build --workspace @vendora/web && npm run build --workspace @vendora/seller-panel && npm run build --workspace @vendora/admin-panel && npm run build --workspace @vendora/api
